intention_examples: editor intends text insertion or deletion
reviewer intends suggestion or comment action
commitment_examples: service commits accepted edit operation under authorization policy
merge component commits conflict-preserving reconciliation outcome

conflict_shape.example: simultaneous incompatible edits on overlapping range

replay_shape.example: reconstruct exact collaborative editing timeline for audit/dispute
replay_shape.expected_behavior: deterministic replay yields document evolution, permissions changes, and unresolved conflicts
